full_judgment: "The trial Court dismissed the suit holding, inter alia, that the plaintiffs could not prove the basis of taking pattan of the suit land by their mother, Parbati Bala Gharami and that the defendant also could not prove the legal foundation of enlisting in the alleged census report the property as vested property (Exhibit-Ka). The trial Court however, found the plaintiffs possession in the suit land. The lower appellate Court set aside the decree of the trial Court and decreed the suit holding, inter alia, that the plaintiff-respondents, on the basis of Exhibit 1(Ka) and 1(Kha) namely, the judgment and decree of Title Suit No. 402 of 1958 and the compromise petition dated 23-8-59 respectively, proved their title to the suit land and that by Exhibit 2 series, 21 dakhilas, the certified copy of the khatians, opened in their mother's name on the basis of the decree of the aforesaid title suit and Exhibit 3 series Choukidari Tax receipts and the oral evidence proved their possession in title suit land and that the defendant could not prove the foundation of making the suit property as vested property. The High Court Division refused to interfere with these findings of fact in revision.
